paper_title: Organic Light-Emitting Transistors Entering a New Development Stage
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2021 - Qin - Organic Light‐Emitting Transistors Entering a New Development Stage/auto/Advanced Materials - 2021 - Qin - Organic Light‐Emitting Transistors Entering a New Development Stage.md

knowledge_points.content: Organic light-emitting transistors (OLETs) integrate the switching and amplification mechanisms of organic field-effect transistors (OFETs) with the electroluminescent characteristics of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) in a single device structure.
knowledge_points.evidence: Organic light-emitting transistors (OLETs...) are possibly the smallest integrated optoelectronic devices that combine the switching and amplification mechanisms of the OFETs and the electroluminescent characteristic of the OLEDs.

knowledge_points.content: The thiophene/phenylene co-oligomer BP3T (o,ω-Bis(biphenylyl)terthiophene) serves as a high-mobility emissive semiconductor with a photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) of 80% and hole/electron mobilities of 1.64 and 0.71 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: o,ω Bis(biphenylyl)terthiophene (BP3T), which is one of the thiophene/phenylene co-oligomers, exhibited a high PLQY of 80% with carrier mobilities of 1.64 and 0.71 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ for the holes and electrons, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Anthracene-based derivatives 2,6-diphenylanthracene (DPA) and 2,6-di(2-naphthyl)anthracene (dNaAnt) exhibit high single-crystal hole mobilities of 34 and 12.3 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ with corresponding PLQY values of 41.2% and 29.2%.
knowledge_points.evidence: 2,6-diphenylanthracene (DPA) and 2,6-di(2-naphthyl)anthracene (dNaAnt) have exhibited superior mobility of 34 and 12.3 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ with PLQY up to 41.2% and 29.2% respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Introducing a rotatable carbon-carbon single bond between an anthracene core and a π-extended moiety is a design strategy used to balance charge transport and emission by reducing fluorescence quenching while maintaining high mobility.
knowledge_points.evidence: we introduced a rotatable carbon-carbon single bond between the anthracene core and π extended moiety for synergetic modulation of the electrical transportation and emission properties.

knowledge_points.content: The External Quantum Efficiency (EQE) of an OLET is defined by the product of the electron-hole balance (γ), the singlet-triplet factor (ηS/T), the photoluminescence quantum yield (ηPL), and the outcoupling efficiency (ηout).
knowledge_points.evidence: The definition of EQE is as follows: EQE = γ × ηS/T × ηPL × ηout

knowledge_points.content: Trilayer OLET structures using DH-4T for hole transport, DHF-4T for electron transport, and an Alq3:DCM blend for emission have achieved an EQE of approximately 5%, significantly outperforming equivalent OLED structures.
knowledge_points.evidence: DH-4T, di(perfluorohexyl-quaterthiophene (DHF-4T), and a blend of host tris(8-hydroxyquinolinato)aluminum (Alq3) and guest 4-(dicyanomethylene)-2-methyl-6-(p-dimethyl-minostyryl)-4Hpyran (DCM) were used... resulted in an EQE of ≈ 5%.

knowledge_points.content: Outcoupling efficiency in OLETs can be enhanced to over 8% by employing a bottom-contact/top-gate configuration and adding a half-sphere to the substrate to improve light collection.
knowledge_points.evidence: the efficiency of the device was improved to a satisfactory value with a peak EQE greater than 8% by adding a half-sphere in the direction of light emission for enhanced light collection.

knowledge_points.content: Phosphorescent material-based OLETs can reach a peak EQE of up to 9.01%, while Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence (TADF) exciplex-based OLETs have demonstrated EQEs of 3.76%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Recently, Meng et al. demonstrated a phosphorescent material-based OLET exhibiting high-performance with an EQE of 9.01%... exciplex TADF material-based OLET... showed a maximum EQE of 3.76%.

knowledge_points.content: OLETs are advantageous for electrically pumped organic lasers because the gate voltage allows the recombination zone to be moved away from the source/drain electrodes, minimizing optical quenching from metal contacts.
knowledge_points.evidence: the unique characteristics of spatially controllable light emission, far away from the electrodes... make OLETs promising candidates for the realization of electrically pumped organic semiconductor lasers.

knowledge_points.content: Theoretical calculations show that the primary optical energy losses in multilayer OLETs are caused by waveguide modes within the active layer and absorption by the silicon gate electrode.
knowledge_points.evidence: analytical results demonstrate that the main optical energy losses in such OLETs are induced by the waveguide mode in the active layer and absorption of the Si gate.

knowledge_points.content: Asymmetric electrode configurations utilizing metals with different work functions (e.g., Au for hole injection and Ca/Al for electron injection) are used to balance charge transport in unipolar p-type OLET materials.
knowledge_points.evidence: constructing an asymmetric device geometry, especially with the incorporation of a low work function (LWF) electrode is a widely used approach in the OLETs for the improvement of electron injection and transportation.

knowledge_points.content: Single-crystal OLETs based on the cyano-substituted styrene derivative βCNDSB exhibit Aggregation-Induced Emission (AIE) with a PLQY of 75% and an EQE of 2.02%.
knowledge_points.evidence: βCNDSB... demonstrated aggregation-induced emission (AIE) characteristic with a PLQY up to 75% in their single-crystal states... EQE of the device reached an unprecedented value of 2.02%.
